core_meaning.literal_meaning: The criterion, the distinguisher of truth from falsehood
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Furqan corresponds to the Arabic form فُرْقان (Arabic root ف ر ق (f-r-q)). Its core sense is criterion, that which distinguishes truth from falsehood. Furqan is the standard transliteration of فُرْقان (Furqān) 'the criterion, the distinguisher of truth from falsehood'.
